clay.delta: Treat Clay-native semantic unity as distinct from semantic failure-domain unity. Add explicit class/cast firebreaks, compact typed handles and coverage/fallback economics to the integrated kernel.
clay.next_experiment: Target/twin cross-class fault factorial with packed handle implementation.

claygraph.delta: Every relation/activation/Assembly used in effect-bound cognition should carry semantic class, origin/authority, selector lineage and epoch ancestry. Activation has no cast to truth/authority. Structural selection attacks and revocation propagation become mandatory tests.
claygraph.next_experiment: Actual ClayGraph origin poisoning × selector mutation × revocation factorial with fixed record bytes.

frank.delta: Keep owner-fixed Clay-native C6 target. Implement HYP-RC4 as semantic compartments inside Clay, mapped onto CognitiveEpochCapsule/CTC rather than as a second architecture. FACT/TEXT tags alone are not a proven security boundary.
frank.next_experiment: C6 target/twin typed semantic-domain enforcement vs tag-only vs untyped under multi-stage memory/tool attacks.

claycode.delta: Extend CC-RC1.4 with first-class semantic-domain/effect typing and explicit legal casts. FORM materialization, proposal→effect and activation→assertion require trusted operations; unknown reflection/plugin casts escalate.
claycode.next_experiment: Property/stateful fuzz of domain-cast algebra plus compositional closure/aliasing.

gwt.delta: Add semantic-domain transition nodes to the intervention DAG. Candidate accessibility, truth assertion, selection, projection, uptake, proposal and effect authorization must remain separately lesionable despite one Clay language.
gwt.next_experiment: Clay-native stage-orthogonal factorial with matched content/order and independent cast interventions.

emergenz.delta: Emergent assemblies must preserve role and semantic-class identity. Cross-domain cascade or recurrence is not emergence; test whether a typed causal handoff motif survives lesion/rescue/OOD while persistence-matched controls do not.
emergenz.next_experiment: Preregister one Clay-native handoff motif with class/cast receipts and run E1 certificate.

hyperposition.delta: Advance HYP-RC3 toward OPEN HYP-RC4: TopologyBasis becomes operation-specific Origin–Selector–Basis capsule plus semantic-domain/cast witnesses and ancestry revocation. Physical layout remains independently optimized.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Live/twin semantic firebreak and revocation cascade audit.

shared_ancestry_note: C6/G10/CC9/GWT4/E1/Fusion/H4 share substantial RAE ancestry. Agreement is not counted as independent replication. Judge0 and external literature are independent only to their tested mechanisms.
